verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a developer platform: its developers page cites 'unified platform and APIs to build custom apps,' plus developer documentation and a sandbox. A live llms.txt is served at developer.rippling.com, and an official GitHub CLI exists for creating and deploying Rippling-hosted integrations. missing for 10: evidence of API endpoint coverage across core actions (payroll, HR, time), details of public authentication and access for customers rather than app partners, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
